name: Todo Resuelto Home Price Index
description: Home-repair prices (plumbers, electricians, gas technicians and other home trades) in 16 Latin American countries, each with a link to its source.
notes: Free, keyless and read-only, with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and a remote MCP server (https://todoresuelto.com/mcp). Updated with each monthly edition. Licence CC BY 4.0.
